evidence.note: clipInference launches the INT8 clip specialization as clipKernel<int8_t, int8_t, 512><<<divUp(n, 512), 512>>> with input/output pointers and n element count.
TensorRT enqueue passes n = mInputVolume * batchSize to clipInference; constraints bind n to input/output element counts.
clipInference launches the HALF storage specialization as clipKernel<float, half, 512><<<divUp(n, 512), 512>>> with input/output pointers and n element count.
TensorRT enqueue passes n = mInputVolume * batchSize to clipInference; constraints bind n to input/output element counts.
clipInference launches the FLOAT specialization as clipKernel<float, float, 512><<<divUp(n, 512), 512>>> with input/output pointers and n element count.
TensorRT enqueue passes n = mInputVolume * batchSize to clipInference; constraints bind n to input/output element counts.
clipInference launches the INT32 specialization as clipKernel<int32_t, int32_t, 512><<<divUp(n, 512), 512>>> with input/output pointers and n element count.
TensorRT enqueue passes n = mInputVolume * batchSize to clipInference; constraints bind n to input/output element counts.
cropAndResizeInference launches cropAndResizeKernel<float> with output_volume and the image, ROI-box, shape, crop, depth, extrapolation, and output arguments.
TensorRT enqueue derives batch, image, box, crop, and depth dimensions from plugin tensor state before calling cropAndResizeInference.
trtModulatedDeformableIm2col launches the float specialization with numKernels, tensor buffers, convolution geometry, group dimensions, and the columns output buffer.
TensorRT enqueue passes float input, offset, mask, workspace, tensor dimensions, kernel shape, stride, padding, dilation, and deformable-group values into the launcher.
